g.text: I just realized who you remind me of.

g.text: A student I got paired with in first year at uni.

g.title: j1905876742
g.text: Uh oh. In a good way?

g.text: An incredibly attractive and brilliant student?

g.title: j1632478682
g.text: I'm bracing for this to not start a fight...

g.title: j2561229719->j1632478682
g.text: false

g.title: j1835820827
g.text: Yes actually.

g.title: j1683440946
g.text: Ew. Hate to break it to you but I don't flirt. Ever.

g.title: j294433034
g.text: Omg please, no, no. This is a happy memory.

g.title: j1738861065
g.text: I was baking a cake to prove you wrong.

g.title: j3977907809
g.text: ESPECIALLY not on the internet.

g.title: j1594413658
g.text: If you say so.

g.title: j1060965115
g.text: You don't seem to have many of those.

g.title: j2033134693
g.text: And it made me think about the only time someone baked a cake for me was this shy classmate.

g.title: j3229626808
g.text: But what if I wanted to?

g.title: j335553754
g.text: Woah my bad. My bad.

g.title: j2556061167
g.text: It's about my birthday actually, but it's not about me.

g.title: j932123066
g.text: Let me share one then!

g.title: j915299915
g.text: Who somehow found out it was my birthday despite me like never being seen with them.

g.title: j716290289
g.text: It'll never be with me.

g.title: j2519689607
g.text: Don't try it again.

g.title: j3980538633
g.text: Well like I guess a bit it was. I should say that um I definitely was the type of person that everyone wanted to be seen with.

g.title: j3412364375
g.text: And they brought me a vanilla cake with vanilla icing, the cake was like three layers tall I swear.

g.title: j2013445877
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4279708313
g.text: I promise I wont.

g.title: j3078063401
g.text: Good grades, beyond good actually. And captain of the cheer-force. It was like a big deal to get invited to my birthday party.

g.title: j3044668994
g.text: Anyway, I saw them with the cake. And I was so worried to have the class see them give ME a cake. We did NOT hang out with the same crowd.

g.title: j3185248370
g.text: Anyway, this student baked me a birthday cake but told me not to share it with anyone and to wait until I got home to eat it.

g.title: j972135761
g.text: I had good grades. Beyond good actually. And captain of the cheer-force. It was like a big deal to get invited to my birthday party.

g.title: j3881378485
g.text: Fine.

g.title: j4231681852
g.text: And to be honest it weirded me out, kind of like you did at first. But then I cut it open and my kitchen knife hit something hard.

g.title: j2886746883
g.text: Gross right? Mega gross. But then I looked and it was like a plastic container they hid under the cake filled with sealed Jinymon Card packs. My favourite things ever.

g.title: j650316563
g.text: But a girl like me would not be caught DEAD with those at school. But obviously this shy kid saw what I was really like and snuck me the real gift while making it look like they wanted my attention with a big cake or something idk.

g.title: j1319803157
g.text: I'm not baking you a cake.

g.title: j1150079266
g.text: For someone who is supposed to be some kid genius you really take a while to make a point...

g.title: j74179843
g.text: And how does that remind you of me exactly?

g.title: j15475854
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3852875601
g.text: And for someone from the great and inspiring future you sure missed the point. Jinymon Cards! ME! Can you believe it?

g.title: j1370238810
g.text: I guess in my own way I'm saying I think I trust you with letting you know I collect Jinymon Cards. They are kind of for losers.

g.title: j3010999530
g.text: Haaahaha!

g.title: j3592378026
g.text: I have no idea what those are!

g.title: j1575313092
g.text: Are they like, special collectors items?

g.title: j573228174
g.text: Or at least I thought. But the real losers were everyone else.

g.title: j2507476560
g.text: It'd probably be gross anyway.

g.title: j338777227
g.text: They're like a kids monster card game and totally kind of for losers, especially in university.

g.title: j2261704773
g.text: Maybe you'll show me your Jinymon Cards one day?

g.title: j3138641856
g.text: Wow, we finished a whole conversation without ONLY talking about time travel!

g.title: j840945092
g.text: Is this you opening up to me? Refreshing!

g.title: j664695240
g.text: You're probably right.

g.title: j3689424522
g.text: I could figure it out.

g.title: j3523530234
g.text: Maybe.

g.title: j3394943810
g.text: Tada!

g.title: j1520834381
g.text: Don't get used to it. Maybe. Ugh IDK.

g.title: j149066286
g.text: Yeahhh yeahh!

g.title: j1895387827
g.text: +20 Chemistry
